title: WCW roots: Windham betrays Lex Luger
summary: After leaving the Horsemen, Lex Luger joins Barry Windham to challenge his former allies. Their championship partnership collapses when Windham chooses the very faction they had beaten.

chapters.title: Luger and Windham beat the Horsemen
chapters.show: JCP Clash of the Champions I
chapters.result: Luger and Windham win the NWA World Tag Team titles from Anderson and Blanchard.
chapters.context: The new partnership gives Luger a victory over the group he left.

chapters.title: Windham changes sides
chapters.result: Windham turns on Luger, allowing Anderson and Blanchard to regain the titles.
chapters.context: The date is the recording date. Windham’s betrayal restores the Horsemen’s tag gold and leaves Luger isolated.
